lines.zh: 我在你头顶飘着，慢慢移。
lines.en: I drift overhead, slowly.
I keep high; my feet never touch soil.
The wind carries me your way.
I pass the treetops without touching.
My shadow slides beneath the clouds.
You look up and I am gone.
I turn in midair.
No sound when I drift.
I glide along the field ridge.

lines.zh: 你走到哪里，我就飘到哪里。
lines.en: Where you walk, I drift.
I pass the roof; no tile stirs.

lines.zh: 天空的云被我碰了一下。
lines.en: The cloud I touched shifts.

lines.zh: 我挂在烟囱上方的气流里。
lines.en: I hang in the updraft above your chimney.
I hover right above your eaves.
That odd sky is my doing.

lines.zh: 我看着你的菜园长得不错。
lines.en: Your garden grows well. I watch.

lines.zh: 飘着的影子比站着更吓人。
lines.en: A floating shadow scares more than one that stands.
I wait for the sun to sink.
The cloud parts; I fold into it.
I hang on. Never landing.

lines.zh: 空中没有声音，只有气流。
lines.en: No sound up here, only air.
I count your trips back and forth.
I rest in your chimney's smoke.
The tree behind your house. I am in it.
Shut the window; I am still out there.
I drift farther than you walk.
Raise your head. Look above.

lines.zh: 你头顶的这个影子，是我。
lines.en: That shadow above you is me.

lines.zh: 我一直在你的视线上方。
lines.en: I have been above your sight line.
Do not shade your eyes. It will not help.

lines.zh: 你一个人在这里，我知道。
lines.en: You are here alone. I know.
Your roof does not stop me.

lines.zh: 我飘得很慢，你跑不过的。
lines.en: I drift slowly, yet you cannot outrun me.

lines.zh: 这里的天空不太正常吧。
lines.en: The sky here looks wrong, does it not?
I watch you count stars.

lines.zh: 你抬头看多久，我就待多久。
lines.en: As long as you look up, I stay.
I do not speak, but I watch.

lines.zh: 你背后的风，是我带起来的。
lines.en: That wind at your back is mine.
Under this sky, only you and I.

lines.zh: 你听见上面有什么了吗？
lines.en: Hear something above?
Twenty blocks up. Perfect distance.

lines.zh: 你不用害怕，我还不想下来。
lines.en: Do not fear. I am not coming down yet.

lines.zh: 我停在你屋脊的正上方。
lines.en: I hover right over your ridge.

lines.zh: 你数过天上有几个影子吗？
lines.en: Have you counted the shadows above?

lines.zh: 我从云里看了你一整夜。
lines.en: I watched you all night from the cloud.
Leave the lamp on. I want a clear look.
I hang in the air as if suspended.
You hit a shadow.
I rise two blocks.

lines.zh: 空气被击穿的声音很怪。
lines.en: The air being pierced sounds wrong.
My outline scatters briefly.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀缺了一角，仍能滑。
lines.en: My wing is chipped, but I can still glide.
My shadow leans to one side.
No pain, but I retreat.
Look up. I am still here.
The wind scatters half of me.

lines.zh: 食物掉下去会脏，我不接。
lines.en: Food would land dirty. I do not take it.

lines.zh: 你举得再高，也够不到我。
lines.en: Hold it higher. You still cannot reach me.
I do not eat. Watching is enough.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我就低一点。
lines.en: Set it down and I descend a little.

lines.zh: 那是给我看的，不是给我的。
lines.en: That is to show me, not for me.
Your offering is in the wrong place.
I smell smoke.

lines.zh: 别往天上扔，会落到你头上。
lines.en: Do not throw it up. It lands on you.
Raise the lamp and I pull back.

lines.zh: 这一点东西，换不来距离。
lines.en: That little will not buy distance.
What you hit was wind.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶掠过，带起凉意。
lines.en: I pass overhead and leave a chill.

lines.zh: 你跳起来了，还是够不到。
lines.en: You jumped. Still short.
I skim along your roof.
The air suddenly sinks. That is me.
The wind took your hat.
Do not reach up. You will lose balance.

lines.zh: 我掠过你的帽檐，带起灰。
lines.en: I skim your hat brim, stirring up ash.
Collisions do not happen to me.

lines.zh: 你的风铃响了，可没有风。
lines.en: Your wind chime rings, though there is no wind.
The sky has no need of pairs.

lines.zh: 我们不需要繁衍，只需要出现。
lines.en: We need no breeding. Only appearing.
Ask the wind that question.
Too late to ask me that.
Only one shadow in this sky.
I have no kin, only watching.
Ask again and I drift closer.
We take no part in ground matters.
Watching the sky is enough.
The wind will carry that topic off.

lines.zh: 你的东西被吹到屋顶了。
lines.en: The wind took your things to the roof.

lines.zh: 我在半空接过一片叶子。
lines.en: I catch a leaf in midair.

lines.zh: 掉下来的瓦，我放在门边。
lines.en: A fallen tile goes by your door.
I do not collect things. I carry wind.

lines.zh: 你晒的谷子被我吹散了。
lines.en: I scattered the grain you set out.
That cloth is now in the tree.
I righted your scarecrow.

lines.zh: 我从上面丢下一根羽毛。
lines.en: I drop a feather from above.
It fell at my feet. Very far below.
You pick it up. I am not coming down.
I begin to descend.
The cloud clears and you see me.
The wind stops. That means I come.
I have your roof marked.

lines.zh: 你听见空气被切开的声音。
lines.en: Hear the air being cut?
I press down from the zenith.
This time I do not drift.

lines.zh: 你在空地上，看不到太多。
lines.en: You are in the open. Not much cover.

lines.zh: 你跑到树下，那不是遮挡。
lines.en: Under a tree? That is no shelter.
I hang directly above you.
The shadow on the ground stops moving.
Count three. Then I come down.
The clouds have all gone.
The air begins pressing down.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了你的菜地。
lines.en: My shadow covers your vegetable patch.
I watch you from above.
I lower myself bit by bit.

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，我都在头顶。
lines.en: Wherever you go, I am overhead.

lines.zh: 影子越来越小，说明我近了。
lines.en: The shadow shrinks as I near.
The wind circles you.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，偏偏照不到。
lines.en: Torch held high, yet it misses me.
I need not land to reach you.

lines.zh: 你呼吸变快了，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breath quickens. I hear it.

lines.zh: 屋顶挡不住从上来的东西。
lines.en: A roof stops nothing from above.
I circle your house.
Shutting the door changes nothing.
I wait for the light to fail.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑，指错方向了。
lines.en: Your sword points the wrong way.
Eight blocks. No hurry.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在你的门口。
lines.en: My shadow lands on your doorstep.
Hear the tiles on your roof?

lines.zh: 我不出声，你也知道我在。
lines.en: Silent, and you still know.
The draft puts out your lamp.

lines.zh: 我再往下降三格，很近了。
lines.en: Three blocks lower. Very close.

lines.zh: 你抬头的那一刻，我停住。
lines.en: The moment you look up, I freeze.
Too late to run now.
I strike down from above.
A cold wind wraps you.

lines.zh: 你没有抬头，是我的机会。
lines.en: You did not look up. My chance.
That impact made no sound.
You hit the ground. I still hang.
My shadow presses on you.
The air is heavy. You gasp.
I graze your shoulder. Cold.

lines.zh: 我从屋檐黑影里俯冲下来。
lines.en: I dive down from the shadow of the eaves.
This time only a touch.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，我已经升高了。
lines.en: You look up. I have risen.

lines.zh: 冷风先到，然后是我的爪。
lines.en: The cold wind arrives first, then my claws.
Something in the wind.

lines.zh: 我压低了，几乎贴着屋脊。
lines.en: I drop low, almost on the ridge.

lines.zh: 你被掀倒了，我仍不落地。
lines.en: You are thrown down. I never land.

lines.zh: 这一下，记在我的注视里。
lines.en: This one goes in my watching.
A dot appears at the sky's edge.
You look up and the cloud has changed.
Wind presses down from above.
I rise behind your house.
A shadow crosses the moon.
The air drops one degree.
I drift to the edge of your sight.
The sky shows two colors.
Wings, high up.
Every bird leaves the wood.
I hang above the canopy.
The sky is restless tonight.
I am here, silently.

lines.zh: 你的烟囱冒出的烟歪了。
lines.en: Your chimney smoke bends.
I wait for your first glance.
Something high is watching you.
Half the moon is covered.
I start my descent. Slowly.
The air is all stillness.

lines.zh: 屋顶上方三格，我停住了。
lines.en: Three blocks above your roof, I stop.
In firelight I go faint.
I am dragged down, then float up.
My shadow breaks on the water.
The blast shoves me far off.
The arrow passes through me.
A spell pins me in midair.
I do not eat. I only drift.

lines.zh: 雷光把整片天空照亮了。
lines.en: Lightning fires the whole sky.
The void is above and below.
